scripts.review:claude: claude -p 'You are a code reviewer for a NextJS/React/TypeScript project. Review the git diff vs main branch and report any issues related to: 1) TypeScript errors, 2) React best practices, 3) Performance issues, 4) Security vulnerabilities, 5) Code style inconsistencies. Format: filename:line - issue description. Be concise and actionable.'
scripts.review:claude:security: claude -p 'You are a security-focused code reviewer. Analyze the git diff vs main for potential security issues: XSS, CSRF, data exposure, authentication bypasses, input validation. Report filename:line - security issue. Only report actual security concerns.'
scripts.review:claude:performance: claude -p 'You are a performance-focused code reviewer for React/NextJS. Analyze git diff vs main for: unnecessary re-renders, bundle size issues, inefficient data fetching, memory leaks. Report filename:line - performance issue.'
